control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT < 60 %, then if LLIGHT < 45 % curve left, else if line tracker > 95 % curve right, else avoidWalls; if RLIGHT >= 60 %, avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70 %, turn right on a LEFT obstacle, turn left on a RIGHT obstacle, else driveInTheDark; if LLIGHT >= 70 %, driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 %, drive forward at 30 %, else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop, else followLine.
followLine: curve left on black, curve right off black.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line with the line tracker, and keep following it when the line runs into a dark tunnel.
